description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Lexer class, which provides functionality for lexing (tokenizing) HTML/SGML markup into tokens, including entity parsing, CDATA handling, and HTML normalization. It serves as an abstract base class with specific implementations like DOMLex and DirectLex.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer
classes.description: Abstract class for lexing HTML/SGML markup into tokens, providing entity parsing, CDATA handling, and normalization functions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a specific lexer implementation based on configuration or environment.

methods.name: parseText
methods.description: Parses a text string, converting entities.

methods.name: parseAttr
methods.description: Parses an attribute string, converting entities.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Converts special entities into characters within a string.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method to lex HTML into tokens; throws exception if called directly.

methods.name: escapeCDATA
methods.description: Converts CDATA sections into escaped form.

methods.name: escapeCommentedCDATA
methods.description: Converts convoluted CDATA sections within comments into escaped form.

methods.name: CDATACallback
methods.description: Callback for processing CDATA sections, escaping their content.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes HTML by converting entities, fixing encoding, and extracting content.

methods.name: extractBody
methods.description: Extracts the body content from an HTML document.
